newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers to slip further,buyers sidelined.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers to slip further,buyers sidelined.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes on Friday fell with shipowners sidelined as overnight crude losses sparked off expectations that prices would ease further.
"Shipowners are holding back, so we are receiving few enquiries," a major said.
Bunker 380-cst prices were quoted at $117 by some majors with independents at $115 per tonne, down from Thursday's $117-$119. Bunker 180-cst prices were also down at between $121-$122 from $122-$124.
MDO prices also eased to $212-$218 and gas oil at $222-$228 on lower diesel prices in the cargo market.
